title: The Dark Web Lab That Hacked Pacemakers to Stop Hearts Remotely
hook: A hidden lab on the dark web was selling exploits that could turn any pacemaker into a kill switch from across the world.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines real fear of medical device hacking with pure evil — viewers will share out of shock and personal safety concern.

title: The Cyberwar Hack That Turned a Country's Power Plant Into a Bomb
hook: By manipulating safety parameters remotely, hackers turned a nuclear reactor's cooling system into a ticking steam explosion.
why_this_can_go_viral: Nuclear disaster fear is universal. The idea that code could cause a Chernobyl-level event will drive massive shares.

title: The Dark Web Marketplace That Sold Zero-Days to Anyone With Bitcoin
hook: For as little as $5,000 in Bitcoin, you could buy a zero-day exploit to break into any Android phone on earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: The low price point — $5,000 for global access — is shocking and makes people realize how cheap their privacy is.

title: The Zero-Day That Hacked Your TV to Film You Through the Screen Reflection
hook: A zero-day exploit used the glossy screen of smart TVs as a mirror to capture your image from across the room.
why_this_can_go_viral: It's a clever, unexpected attack vector. People will look at their TV differently after watching.

title: The Surveillance System That Tracked Your Car's Vibration to Know When You Have Sex
hook: A smart parking lot system used vibration sensors to detect 'suspicious activity' — including intimate moments in parked cars.
why_this_can_go_viral: High shock and humor value mixed with outrage. Viewers will share because of the sheer awkwardness and overreach.

title: The Cyberwar History: The Hack That Made Enemy Soldiers See Ghosts
hook: A nation-state used hacked AR displays on military helmets to project phantom figures onto the battlefield, causing mass panic.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines sci-fi horror with real military tech. The idea of fighting ghosts created by code is uniquely terrifying.

title: The Dark Web Lab That Hacked Smart Smoke Detectors to Fake House Fires
hook: A lab sold a tool that triggered smart smoke alarms in hundreds of homes simultaneously, sending fire trucks on wild goose chases.
why_this_can_go_viral: High panic potential. Viewers will imagine their home filling with smoke they can't trust — a primal fear.

title: The AI That Hacked Your Electric Blanket to Overheat While You Slept
hook: An AI exploit turned smart electric blankets into silent heaters that raised body temperature to dangerous levels overnight.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral and intimate — you're most vulnerable while sleeping. The idea of your bed turning against you is nightmare fuel.

title: The Surveillance System That Hacked Restroom Mirrors to Record Video
hook: Smart mirrors in public restrooms were secretly sending video feeds to a private server — all hidden behind the reflective glass.
why_this_can_go_viral: Invades ultimate private space. Outrage and voyeurism fear will drive massive shares and discussion.

title: The Nation-State Hack That Poisoned Online Maps to Send Soldiers Into Swamps
hook: A state actor altered GPS map data for a military convoy, redirecting them into a marsh where vehicles got stuck and ambushed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns a trusted navigation tool into a weapon. Viewers will question every digital map they use.

title: The Zero-Day That Hacked Your Vape Pen to Inhale Your Personal Data
hook: A zero-day in smart vape pens let attackers siphon your contacts, messages, and location data through the device's Bluetooth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable for millions of vapers. The absurd combination of vaping and hacking catches attention immediately.

title: The Social Engineer Who Hacked a Casino by Making Slot Machines 'Jackpot' on Command
hook: He didn't hack the code — he hacked the technician's ego, convincing him to reveal the master reset code over a beer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the allure of casino heists with pure psychological manipulation. Viewers love the 'how did he do that?' factor.

title: The Cyberwar History: The Hack That Deleted a Country's Entire Tax Database
hook: A single remote command erased a decade of tax records for an entire nation, collapsing its economy for months.
why_this_can_go_viral: High stakes, huge scale, and visceral real-world impact. The idea that a few keystrokes can cripple a country is terrifying.
